note: The citing work maps detected stencil idioms to Halide DSL as one of two target DSLs (alongside Lift), making Halide a tool/target in their pipeline rather than just a list example, but the cited paper (Helium) is about lifting binaries to Halide, which is a different contribution from what this work targets; the abstract names Halide as a destination DSL without specifically crediting Helium, so the connection to the cited paper specifically is unclear.
title: Automatic Matching of Legacy Code to Heterogeneous APIs
